name: edakit
displayName: edakit – EasyEDA Pro from a hardware graph
description: From a JSON hardware graph to a released, manufacturable PCB with EasyEDA Pro: skills and agents for the workflow, the pinned easyeda-mcp-pro server, a hook that lets parallel sessions share EasyEDA, and the edakit command line (checks, ngspice simulation, schematic and PCB generation, Freerouting, release gate).
